text: Joseph starts at the council on Monday 3rd of November, 9am sharp. Bit nervous about the commute apparently.
lunch w Ioana - she's gone vegan since sept, no dairy at all. her mum's retiring 28/11 after 30 yrs nursing
Remind me to text Arjun good luck tomorrow morning, his first day as team lead.
Farah's brother Kieran got promoted to sous chef. She says he only drinks oat flat whites, worth knowing if he comes over.
So Shreya was saying her husband's leaving drinks are on Friday at 6 at the Crown, and she wants me to come but I've got the dentist, so I'll probably just pop in late.
Varun - coeliac. Proper coeliac, not just avoiding bread. Check the menu before the 14th.

Hoang's dad had his hip done last week, home now but grumpy and refusing to use the frame. Hoang sounded worn out on the phone, he's been going round every morning before work and every evening after, plus his own kids have half term. His sister Chloe is flying back from Dubai on the 2nd to take over for a fortnight. His dad's diabetic too so all the meals need planning.
chloe new job at the bakery on station rd, starts thurs 6am!! can't eat nuts tho which is funny for a baker
Need to get Chioma a card, she retires 19 December. Twenty two years at the library.
Suzanne mentioned her son Mateo's interview at the bank is on the 12th at half 9. He's a wreck about it, hasn't slept properly.
Jamal doesn't drink, never has. Loves really strong ginger beer though.
Picked up the dry cleaning, booked the car in for 4 Nov at 8am.

Reza called. His wife Dana is expecting, due early March, they had the 12 week scan on Monday morning and everything looked good. They're over the moon. He's also switching to nights at the warehouse from next week, which she's not thrilled about, and his mum keeps phoning every day with advice. Dana's off coffee completely and craving pickled onions, which Reza finds hilarious. Should drop off a little something for them before Christmas.
Rachel's leaving party got cancelled, her boss talked her into staying another six months. She's fine with it, sort of.
Owen and his partner are hosting Sunday lunch on the 9th at 1. Owen says no pork, his partner's Muslim. I'm bringing dessert.
note to self: Nasser hates coriander. like genuinely gags. don't do the green curry
Thabo's sister Neha just got into med school in Leeds, starts 1st of October next year. Thabo was beaming. I should send her something small, maybe a nice pen.

Dictated walking back: Deepa's mum is coming over from Pune on 22 November, flight lands at about 7 in the evening, and she's staying till January. Deepa's a bit stressed, flat's tiny and her mum is strictly vegetarian, no eggs either, so Deepa's been practising dal every night.
eva got the promotion!! head of marketing from 1 Jan. send congrats tonight
Kwame's last day at Fischer & Co was yesterday. Ask him how the send off went.
Anan said his kids are both lactose intolerant now, the younger one only just diagnosed. Something to remember for Halloween.
Juan - into natural wine, hates anything sweet. Birthday sometime in May, think the 17th? Dropping hints about a decanter.

Gareth Evans retires on Friday 31 October after 35 years in the accounts team. Leaving do at 4pm in the canteen, then the pub after for anyone still standing. His wife Suzanne is coming in for the speeches. He wants to spend retirement on his allotment and touring Wales in the camper. Real ale man, no lager. I need to chip in for the collection before Thursday.

Ming is moving to Bristol for a new role at the university, research fellow in marine biology, starting 5/01. Her partner Owen is staying here until the summer to finish his contract, which she's dreading. She's viewing flats on Saturday 15 November at 11 and again on the Sunday afternoon. Their cat Noodle is going with her. Help her with boxes the weekend before she goes.
Abigail's first day back after maternity leave is tomorrow. She's anxious about leaving the baby at nursery. Message her tomorrow evening to see how it went.
Grabbed coffee w Chidi. He's off gluten and dairy for some elimination diet the GP suggested. Has his follow up appt on 18/11 at 10.
Olivia's grandad turns 90 on the 2nd of December. Big family dinner, she's doing a cake, he only likes Victoria sponge.

kieran quit!! handed in notice today, last day 21 Nov. going freelance doing web design, his girlfriend Abigail is backing him which is lovely. bit worried about money but he's saved six months. leaving drinks prob the thurs before at 6ish. he's vegan now btw, so no meat platters. ask him how it's going in a month or so
Call Ioana on Thursday at lunchtime about her sister's wedding menu, she wanted my halal caterer contact.
Arjun's wife Shreya has her nursing exam on 3rd of December at 2pm. He says she's been revising every night and is terrified.
Joe (Joseph) says his new manager is an absolute nightmare. Third week in and already thinking of leaving.
Farah only drinks peppermint tea after 2pm, caffeine messes with her sleep. Also allergic to kiwi.
Don't forget: Varun's leaving do, Wednesday at 5:30, the Lamb on Grove St. Get him a card first.
Was chatting to Hoang at the school gate. His daughter starts Year 7 at a new school after half term, she's really nervous. He's also gone pescatarian.
Chloe Santos, the new hire on our floor. Started today, previously at Garcia's. Lactose free milk in the fridge is hers.

Long call with Chioma. Her son Kwame finally got his apprenticeship confirmed, starts 10 November at 8 in the morning, two hour commute. Her husband retires at Christmas and she's worried he'll drive her mad at home. Their dog Biscuit had a lump removed last Tuesday, all fine. Remind me to ring her next week to see how Biscuit's healing.
suzanne - teetotal since june. likes elderflower presse. husband Gareth is the opposite lol
Jamal's promotion party is Saturday at 8. I'm driving so I'll be on lemonade.
Must ask Reza about his job interview on the 14th, it was at 11am, forgot to check in after.
Rachel's daughter Eva has a nut allergy, a serious one, carries an EpiPen. Remember when they come round on the 30th.
Owen started at the garage two weeks ago. Loves it, but the early starts are killing him. He's on 7am shifts Mon to Fri.
Need to buy oat milk, gluten free pasta and a bottle of red before Saturday.
Nasser's mum passed away last month. He's back at work on Monday the 27th, I should text him Sunday night.
Thabo's partner Dana is a pastry chef, just got headhunted by a hotel in town. Starts 1st Dec. Thabo says the free croissants alone are worth it.
Deepa wants a new coffee grinder, keeps going on about burr grinders. Christmas idea.

Eva after yoga. Her brother Juan is getting married 14 May next year in Seville, ceremony at 5pm then dinner on a rooftop. She's been asked to give a speech and is properly dreading it, she hates public speaking. Their dad isn't well enough to fly so they're sorting a video link. Juan's fiancee Ming is vegetarian and wants the whole menu veggie, which their gran is apparently furious about.
Dana's job interview got moved to Tuesday at 3pm. Text her that morning, good luck.
Kwame and his wife are doing Dry January, and he's already planning the 1st of Feb pub trip.
I'm doing the food for Anan's retirement lunch on 7th November, 12:30 at his house. Six people, two vegetarians, one no onion or garlic.
Neha said her boss is leaving end of the month and she might get bumped up. Fingers crossed. Find out next week.
Mrs Gupta next door, Neha's mum, is having cataract surgery 10/11 at 9am. Neha's taking her. Offer to feed the cat, Pepper, while they're out.
Juan's brother Mateo has been made redundant from the factory. Juan says he's taking it hard. Mateo has a meeting with the union Thursday morning.
Gareth - only eats spicy food, the hotter the better. Grows his own chillies.
Mateo got the job at the bank after all!! starts Monday 17th at half 8. Suzanne is relieved.
Ming's flat warming is off, the move fell through. She's gutted. Maybe take her for dinner one evening this week.
Gym session Thurs 7am, then haircut at 12. Pick up the parcel after.

Abigail's husband Chidi is turning 40 on 6 December. She's planning a surprise meal at 7:30 at Nando's because he's obsessed with their peri peri chicken, extra hot, nothing else will do. His brother Kwame is flying in from Lagos the day before and staying with us. She asked if I'd help with the guest list, and hinted he'd love a new pair of running trainers.
Kieran's mum Olivia, aka Liv, is retiring from the NHS on the 15th of January. Thinking of getting her a nice bottle of gin, she loves a G&T.
Chidi and Abigail are both off sugar for November, raising money for diabetes UK. Sponsor them before the 30th.

Voice note: right, so Olivia's starting her new job at the hospice on the 3rd of November, she's doing nights, 8pm to 8am, and her mum's moving in with them the same week to help with the kids, which is a lot. Olivia sounded exhausted. Also she's gone completely off caffeine, so no coffee. Remember to drop round with some food that weekend, something veggie because her eldest won't eat meat.
